faqData.q: What is your main area of expertise?
faqData.a: I specialize in AI/ML and Generative AI engineering — building RAG pipelines, LLM applications, predictive models, NLP systems, and MLOps/LLMOps workflows with Python, Azure OpenAI, LangChain, and cloud deployment on AWS, Azure, and GCP.

faqData.q: What GenAI technologies do you work with?
faqData.a: I work with GPT-4, Claude, LLaMA, Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, LangChain, LlamaIndex, FAISS, Pinecone, ChromaDB, embeddings, vector search, prompt engineering, and LLM evaluation frameworks like LangSmith and OpenAI Evals.

faqData.q: What MLOps tools do you use?
faqData.a: I use MLflow, Airflow, Kubeflow, SageMaker Pipelines, Docker, Kubernetes, GitHub Actions, and CI/CD pipelines for experiment tracking, model versioning, batch inference, and real-time inference deployment.

faqData.q: How do you ensure responsible AI deployment?
faqData.a: I implement PII masking, hallucination detection, groundedness checks, human-in-the-loop review flows, audit logging, and compliance validation to support secure AI adoption for sensitive enterprise data.

faqData.q: How can we start a partnership or project?
faqData.a: The most efficient way is to use the contact form above or reach out directly via email at jasper.dasari@applywizard.ai. I respond within 24 hours to discuss opportunities.
